summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The release discloses net income of $17.4 million, fleet utilization of 95.1%, and declared quarterly distributions of $0.5625 per Series A Preferred Unit and $0.050 per common unit. No special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes are mentioned; this is a routine earnings announcement with CEO commentary on market conditions. The filing is a standard periodic report with no event triggering special-situations classification.
